name: Purple Nursing Mug (14 oz)
seoTitle: Purple Nursing Mug for Nurses Week Gifts
metaDescription: A 14 oz purple nursing mug suited to RNs, LPNs, nurse practitioners, and students. A cheerful pick for Nurses Week, retirement, or graduation.
summary: A 14 oz purple mug made for nurses of every level, from LPN to NP. A cheerful, versatile gift for Nurses Week, a birthday, or retirement.
whyItWorks: Purple is a favorite color for a lot of nurses, and a mug in that shade stands out on a crowded break room counter where every other cup is plain white. That alone helps it avoid the usual problem of mugs walking off or getting mixed up during a busy shift.

The 14 oz size gives a bit more room than a standard mug, so there is space for that extra splash of coffee before a 7 a.m. start. It is described for RNs, LPNs, nurse practitioners, and nursing students, which makes it a flexible choice when you are buying for a group with different titles. Give it for Nurses Week, a birthday, a graduation from nursing school, or a retirement party for a nurse who has spent years caring for others. We like it filled with a few treats, like flavored coffee pods or chocolates, and tied with a ribbon. It is simple, but it gets used every day.
goodToKnow: Check the listing photos for the design and wording printed on the mug.
Confirm care instructions, such as dishwasher and microwave use, on the listing.
Works for many nursing roles, which helps with group gifts.

faq.q: Is this mug suitable for an LPN?
faq.a: Yes. It is described for RNs, LPNs, nurse practitioners, and students, so it fits many nursing roles.

faq.q: Is a mug a good retirement gift for a nurse?
faq.a: A mug works well as part of a retirement gift, especially paired with a card or something personal from the team.
